name: Premier Energy & Infrastructure Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1988, Premier Energy & Infrastructure Ltd is in the infrastructure business[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
PEIL is focused on the construction, housing development, and energy sector. It undertook estate development projects with a business focus on residential and commercial developments. The company has also expanded to develop infrastructural facilities in Power generation.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.97 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 5.12% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Promoters have pledged or encumbered 85.9% of their holding.
